camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --MaxResults 10 --LogField src_ip --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Groups protocol logs by a specified field, counts the number of logs for each field value, and returns a specified number of groups. You can first call ListProtoLogSupportIndex to select fields whose SupportGroupBy parameter is set to true
description_zh: 按指定字段对协议日志分组并统计各字段值出现的日志条数，返回指定数量的分组。可先通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 选择 SupportGroupBy 为 true 的字段
name: DescribeProtoLogFieldStatistics

parameters.help_en: The log filter conditions, specified as a JSON string. The logicOp parameter can be and or or. The logFilterItems parameter is an array of conditions, where each item contains logField, op, and value, with value being a string. The logFilters parameter can nest condition groups of the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field filtering is applied. You can obtain the available fields and operators by calling ListProtoLogSupportIndex
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than ToTime. We recommend that you specify both the start time and the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than FromTime. If FromTime and ToTime are the same, the system queries logs within the time range from 1 second before ToTime to ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The name of the log field used for grouping and statistics. This parameter cannot be empty. Use a field that is returned by ListProtoLogSupportIndex and whose SupportGroupBy parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 分组统计的日志字段名，不能为空。使用 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 返回且 SupportGroupBy 为 true 的字段
parameters.name: log_field

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of groups to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 最多返回的分组数量，取值为 1～100。该参数必须传入
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to sort the results by log count in ascending order. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false or an unspecified value indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 是否按日志条数升序排列。true 表示升序；false 或不传表示降序
parameters.name: order_by_count_asc

parameters.help_en: The site for log query. You can obtain the value from the Sites parameter returned by DescribeDeliveryDestination. In multi-site scenarios, a valid specified site is used first. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an available site. If only one site is available, that site is used. If no site is available, LogDeliveryNotOpen is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_en: The grouping and statistics results of the field. This parameter may be empty if no matching data is found
Data.description_zh: 字段分组统计结果；无匹配数据时可能为空

LogField.description_en: The name of the field used for grouping and statistics in this request
LogField.description_zh: 本次分组统计使用的字段名

TopList.description_en: The list of field value groups, sorted in the order specified by OrderByCountAsc. The number of groups does not exceed the value of MaxResults
TopList.description_zh: 字段值分组列表，按 OrderByCountAsc 指定的顺序排列，数量不超过 MaxResults

LogFieldKey.description_en: The field value corresponding to the group

ProtoLogCount.description_en: The number of protocol logs corresponding to the field value
ProtoLogCount.description_zh: 该字段值对应的协议日志条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request is successful. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The message about the request result. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to identify the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of true indicates that the request was successful. A value of false indicates that the request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
